component.name: Bustle
component.summary: Draw sequence diagrams of D-Bus activity

description.p: Bustle draws sequence diagrams of D-Bus activity. It shows signal emissions, method calls and their corresponding returns, with time stamps for each individual event and the duration of each method call. This can help you check for unwanted D-Bus traffic, and pinpoint why your D-Bus-based application is not performing as well as you like. It also provides statistics like signal frequencies and average method call times.
This is the Ruby GTK4 and Libadwaita port of Bustle.
First release of the Ruby port: open pcap logs of D-Bus traffic, explore them as sequence diagrams with a details pane and statistics, filter services, and export the diagram as a PDF.
